company.name: Turion Space
company.shortDescription: Turion Space develops spacecraft and software for space awareness, in-orbit operations, and satellite servicing systems.
company.description: Turion Space develops and operates spacecraft and software systems designed to support space domain awareness, in-orbit operations, and satellite servicing. The company builds integrated platforms that combine satellites, propulsion systems, and software to enable tasks such as monitoring space objects, gathering orbital data, and performing rendezvous or maintenance missions. Its DROID satellite fleet is designed for mobility and interaction in orbit, including debris mitigation and servicing of existing satellites to extend their operational lifespan. The company also provides software systems, such as its Starfire platform, which support mission planning, autonomous tasking, and command and control of satellite constellations. Its approach emphasizes in-house development of mission components and integration of hardware and software to support both government and commercial space operations.
